clauses.text: We collect your name, email address, precise location, contacts, and in-app activity to provide and improve our services.
We may share personal information with service providers, business partners, and other third parties for analytics and personalized advertising.
We retain information as long as necessary for our business purposes and applicable obligations.
You may request access to or correction of certain data by emailing privacy@socialapp.example.
We may also use submitted content for model training and to improve artificial intelligence features.

findings.title: Personalized advertising

gaps.note: The document should list the categories of data it collects.
The document should explain why it uses the data.
A specific period helps people understand how long their data remains.
Naming or categorizing recipients reduces ambiguity.
People should know how to close an account and delete their data.
The policy should explain what happens to backups after deletion.
The policy should clarify whether content is used to train models.

impacts.scenario: Frequent location data may reveal routines, regularly visited places, and movement patterns.
More recipients increase exposure and make the data trail harder to follow.
Content could enter model-training processes depending on the provider's controls and terms.
Activity may be combined to infer interests and personalize content or advertising.

actions.text: Restrict location access to “only while using the app,” or disable it when unnecessary.
Review settings that limit advertising, analytics, and partner sharing.
Look for an AI-training opt-out and avoid submitting sensitive content.
Turn off ad personalization and limit cross-app tracking.
Before accepting, find the deletion procedure or request that information from the provider.
